extracted.intended_audience: readers of classic satirical literature; students and scholars of Rabelais; those studying early-modern humor
extracted.subtask_description: Close reading of an excerpt from Rabelais' Gargantua and Pantagruel (discourses on marriage, cuckoldry, and women) aimed at understanding its satirical and comedic devices. Useful for literary analysis, humor studies, or classroom discussion of early-modern satire.
